subject.title: [Bug]: Ctrl+C not working in Windows install on foreground

question: Should this issue wait for native Windows npm-global Ctrl+C reproduction before a new repair PR is queued?
rationale: Current source already handles delivered SIGINT, so automation cannot safely choose between a shell/npm signal-delivery fix and a Gateway shutdown fix without Windows proof.

options.title: Require Windows live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open until PowerShell, cmd.exe, or Windows Terminal proof shows whether Ctrl+C reaches the foreground `openclaw gateway run` process on current main or v2026.6.11.

options.title: Queue after signal-delivery proof
options.body: If proof shows Ctrl+C is not delivered through the native npm-global path, queue a narrow stdin/signal bridge repair with cleanup coverage and Windows package proof.

options.title: Close if current Windows works
options.body: If a native Windows npm-global run on current main and the latest release exits cleanly on Ctrl+C, close this issue as not reproducible with that proof.

recommendation.title: Require Windows live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until PowerShell, cmd.exe, or Windows Terminal proof shows whether Ctrl+C reaches the foreground `openclaw gateway run` process on current main or v2026.6.11.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal points to repeated Gateway lifecycle and foreground command work in the affected files.
